note: The downloads shelf. Regenerate the service worker with tools/build_index.py after editing.

sections.title: Offline Wikipedia & reference
sections.note: Wikipedia and whole reference libraries as ZIM files, read completely offline in the free Kiwix app. Install Kiwix first, then pick your content.

items.name: Kiwix Desktop for Windows (64-bit)
items.note: Free GPL reader that opens ZIM files with zero internet. Portable ZIP, no installer needed. Get this first, then the content files below. 150 MB (v2.5.1).

items.name: Kiwix for Android (direct APK)
items.note: Official APK straight from Kiwix - sideload before you leave connectivity. Also on Google Play. Reads ZIM files off the SD card. 225 MB (v3.14.1), free/GPL.

items.name: Kiwix for iPhone and iPad (App Store)
items.note: Official free Kiwix reader for iOS/iPadOS; same app listing serves macOS. Download ZIM files in-app while online, then read entirely offline. Size varies by device.

items.name: Kiwix all-platform download page (macOS, Linux, browser add-ons)
items.note: Every official Kiwix build in one place: macOS DMG (5.9 MB), Linux AppImage (160 MB), Flatpak, kiwix-serve, and Chrome/Firefox/Edge extensions. All free and open source.

items.name: Kiwix Library - browse and download ZIM content packages
items.note: Official catalog of thousands of free ZIM files: Wikipedia, Stack Exchange, Gutenberg, TED, medical and how-to collections. Filter by language and size. Sizes vary.

items.name: Simple English Wikipedia (with images) - ZIM
items.note: Best size-to-value pick: plain-language Wikipedia, images included, opens in Kiwix. 3.3 GB (June 2026). A no-pictures version is 944 MB. Text is CC BY-SA.

items.name: Full English Wikipedia, text only (no images) - ZIM
items.note: All ~6.9M English articles, images stripped to save space. The reference backbone of an offline library. 49 GB (June 2026), CC BY-SA. Use a download manager.

items.name: WikiMed - offline medical encyclopedia (MDWiki) - ZIM
items.note: Curated medical reference built from Wikipedia's health articles, images included. Written for use where no doctor or internet is available. 2.1 GB, CC BY-SA.

items.name: WikEM emergency medicine reference - ZIM
items.note: Point-of-care emergency medicine wiki used by clinicians - fast lookups for acute problems. 357 MB (July 2026). Free download via Kiwix; see WikEM for reuse terms.

items.name: Post-disaster survival collection (Zimgit) - ZIM
items.note: Purpose-built offline pack for losing power, water, and comms: shelter, sanitation, first aid, repair. Exactly the case this library exists for. 615 MB, free.

items.name: Essential medical guides (Zimgit Medicine) - ZIM
items.note: Small, high-value first-aid and treatment guides for austere settings. 67 MB - fits on any phone alongside everything else. Free download from Kiwix.

items.name: Safe drinking water guide (Zimgit Water) - ZIM
items.note: Finding, filtering, and disinfecting water when the tap fails. Only 20 MB, so there is no reason not to carry it. Free download from Kiwix.

items.name: Food preparation and preservation (Zimgit) - ZIM
items.note: Cooking, canning, and food-storage instructions for no-power situations. 93 MB. Free download from Kiwix; opens in the Kiwix reader.

items.name: English Wiktionary, text only - ZIM
items.note: Complete offline dictionary: definitions, etymologies, and translations across languages. Pairs with Wikipedia for homeschool and study. 8.5 GB (May 2026), CC BY-SA.

items.name: Army Publishing Directorate (armypubs) mirror - ZIM
items.note: Offline snapshot of the Army's public publications site - regulations, field manuals, forms. US federal works, public domain. 7.6 GB (June 2024 crawl).

items.name: Kiwix PWA - read ZIM files in a browser, no install
items.note: Official Kiwix web app; install once and it works offline, opening ZIM files from your own drive. Useful on locked-down or government computers. Free.

sections.title: Survival & preparedness
sections.note: Field manuals and preparedness guides from official sources — public domain or officially free. Print or keep on the device you'd actually have with you.

items.name: ATP 3-50.21, Survival (US Army, Sept 2018) — full PDF
items.note: Current official Army survival doctrine (supersedes FM 21-76): water, food, fire, shelter, navigation, knots. US federal work, public domain. PDF, 23 MB.

items.name: ATP 4-02.11, Casualty Response, TCCC, and First Aid (Mar 2026)
items.note: Army's current first-aid manual for non-medics; replaced TC 4-02.1 (now inactive). Bleeding, airway, hypothermia, evacuation. Public domain. PDF, 12 MB.

items.name: Are You Ready? An In-Depth Guide to Citizen Preparedness
items.note: FEMA's ~200-page all-hazards household manual: plans, kits, every major disaster type. The single best offline preparedness book. Public domain. PDF, 4 MB.

items.name: Ready.gov Hazard Information Sheets — complete set in one PDF
items.note: All 16 FEMA hazard sheets (flood, tornado, wildfire, power outage, pandemic, tsunami...) bundled as one printable file. Public domain. PDF, 4 MB.

items.name: Thunderstorms, Tornadoes, Lightning — NWS preparedness booklet
items.note: NOAA/NWS booklet on severe storm science, watches vs. warnings, and shelter decisions. Useful when no radar or phone alerts. Public domain. PDF, 14 MB.

items.name: NWS Publications and Brochures library (all safety PDFs)
items.note: Official index of ~80 NWS safety PDFs: flood, heat, hurricane, lightning, tornado, tsunami, winter, plus Spanish. Download the set before going offline. Size varies.

items.name: USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning, 2015 revision (8 PDFs)
items.note: The authoritative US food-preservation reference, split into 8 downloadable parts. USDA work, public domain; hosted by NCHFP at UGA. Size varies (intro ~0.5 MB).
items.source: USDA / National Center for Home Food Preservation

items.name: Making Water Safe During an Emergency (CDC fact sheet)
items.note: Printable CDC sheet on boiling, bleach ratios, and filtering when tap water is unsafe. Core offline skill. Public domain. PDF, 0.7 MB.

items.name: Emergency Disinfection of Drinking Water (EPA)
items.note: EPA's exact unscented-bleach and iodine dosing tables plus cloudy-water procedure. Save the page; it is the number most guides get wrong. Public domain.

items.name: Keep Your Food Safe During Emergencies: Power Outages, Floods, Fires
items.note: USDA FSIS rules for fridge/freezer hold times, what to discard, and flood-contaminated food. Public domain; HTML page, save for offline.
items.source: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service

items.name: How to Create and Store an Emergency Water Supply (CDC)
items.note: How much water per person per day, container choice, sanitizing, and rotation schedule. Pairs with the CDC treatment sheet. Public domain; HTML page.

items.name: Emergency Supply Kit Checklist (Ready.gov)
items.note: One-page printable build-a-kit list — the fastest thing to hand someone before a deployment or storm. Public domain. PDF, 150 KB.

items.name: Family Emergency Communication Plan (fillable card, 2025)
items.note: Fillable wallet-card plan for contacts and meeting places — built for families separated by distance or deployment. Public domain. PDF, 625 KB.

items.name: Winter Storms: The Deceptive Killers (NWS preparedness guide)
items.note: NWS guide to wind chill, hypothermia, vehicle kits, and staying warm without power. Public domain. PDF, 1.6 MB.

items.name: FEMA Guide to Emergency Alerts and Warnings
items.note: Explains WEA, EAS, and NOAA Weather Radio — how warnings still reach you when cell data and internet are down. Public domain. PDF, 1.7 MB.

sections.title: Medical & first aid
sections.note: Legally free medical references built for use where there is no doctor and no signal.

items.name: TCCC Guidelines, 01 May 2026 (current CoTCCC edition)
items.note: Verified PDF, first page reads 'TCCC Guidelines 01 May 2026'. Care Under Fire/Tactical Field Care/TACEVAC. US federal work, public domain. 314 KB.

items.name: ATP 4-02.11 - Casualty Response, Tactical Combat Casualty Care, and First Aid
items.note: March 2026 Army doctrine, supersedes TC 4-02.1. Bleeding, airway, hypothermia, CBRN, bites/stings, climatic injury. Public domain. 12.7 MB PDF.

items.name: WikiMed: Wikipedia Medicine offline archive (ZIM)
items.note: Not covered by any other item here. ~75k medical articles, reads in Kiwix with no internet. CC BY-SA. 2.2 GB maxi; nopic 822 MB, mini 155 MB also on that server.

items.name: WikEM emergency medicine reference, offline archive (ZIM)
items.note: Largest open-access emergency medicine reference, packaged for offline Kiwix use. Content licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. 375 MB maxi; nopic build 347 MB.

items.name: Joint Trauma System Clinical Practice Guidelines (100+ CPGs)
items.note: DoD trauma CPGs as free PDFs, plus complete A-H / I-Z zip bundles and a Top 10 Operational Readiness set for bulk offline download. Public domain. Size varies.

items.name: MedlinePlus Health Topic XML bulk download
items.note: Full English/Spanish consumer health topic set as XML, rebuilt daily. Use the compressed .zip (~4.6 MB; raw XML ~29 MB). US government work, public domain.

items.name: MSF Clinical Guidelines: Diagnosis and Treatment Manual
items.note: Field manual for austere settings. Free download from MSF's own site, but all rights reserved: personal offline use only, no redistribution. 6.8 MB PDF.

items.name: MDWiki Medical Encyclopedia offline archive (ZIM)
items.note: WikiProjectMed-curated healthcare articles, the source behind the WikiMed app. Complements WikiMed rather than duplicating it. CC BY-SA. 2.3 GB.

sections.title: Offline maps
sections.note: Topographic maps, charts and offline map apps from official and open sources. Download your area before you need it.

items.name: Organic Maps — offline OpenStreetMap navigation app
items.note: Offline OSM maps with turn-by-turn nav; no ads, no tracking, no signal needed. Apache 2.0 open source. Download map regions per country/state; size varies.

items.name: OsmAnd — offline maps, routing, contour lines
items.note: Offline OSM maps with routing plus contour/hillshade plugins for terrain. Open source, free tier, Android/iOS. Regions downloaded per country/state; size varies.

items.name: The National Map Downloader — US Topo GeoPDF quads
items.note: Free current US Topo maps as layered, georeferenced GeoPDF; full coverage of 50 states, PR, USVI and Alaska. Public domain USGS data; size varies.

items.name: USGS topoBuilder — custom OnDemand Topo PDF for any area
items.note: Generate and download a topo PDF centered wherever you choose, not just standard quads. Public domain, free; size varies. JS app — verify in a browser.

items.name: National Park Service map catalog (1,000+ printable park maps)
items.note: Official NPS maps from Harpers Ferry Center, free as PDF or JPEG for printing before you lose signal. US federal work, public domain; size varies.

items.name: NOAA ENC Chart Downloader — free US nautical charts
items.note: Official NOAA electronic navigational charts free by chart, state, region or Coast Guard district. S-57 zips for chart plotters/OpenCPN. All US ENCs = 789 MB.

items.name: NOAA Custom Chart — build a printable PDF nautical chart
items.note: Make a paper-style, georeferenced PDF chart for any area from current NOAA ENC data, then print or store it. Free federal data; app at devgis.charttools.noaa.gov/pod.

items.name: FAA digital VFR charts — sectionals and TACs (GeoTIFF)
items.note: FAA's own file directory of georeferenced raster VFR charts, 300 dpi GeoTIFF in zips, foldered by 56-day effective date. Public domain; large files, size varies.

items.name: FHWA National Highway System maps — PDF, every state
items.note: Statewide and urban-area highway maps as PDFs for all 50 states, downloadable singly or as one zip per state. US federal work, public domain; size varies.

items.name: Geofabrik OpenStreetMap extracts (.osm.pbf) by country and state
items.note: Daily OSM data extracts by continent, country and US state for offline map apps and self-hosted routing. ODbL 1.0, free download server; size varies by region.

items.name: US Forest Service maps and Motor Vehicle Use Maps
items.note: Free digital forest maps and MVUMs to download and print for national forests and grasslands. US federal work; some printed visitor maps are sold separately.

items.name: Natural Earth — public domain world basemap data
items.note: Free vector and raster world map data at 1:10m, 1:50m and 1:110m for offline GIS or printing. Public domain terms. Quick start kit 219 MB; all vectors 576 MB.

sections.title: Full textbooks (PDF)
sections.note: Complete, legally free college textbooks — download the PDF once and it is yours. Most pair with subjects taught on this site.

items.name: OpenStax — full catalog of free college textbooks (PDF download hub)
items.note: OpenStax's whole catalog: 100+ peer-reviewed college texts, each book page has a Download-a-PDF button. Bulk-download before you lose signal. CC licensed; books run 30-450 MB.

items.name: OpenStax Biology 2e
items.note: Full majors-level biology textbook, 1,500+ pages with figures. Official page with PDF download. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. PDF is 383 MB — large, plan storage.

items.name: OpenStax Chemistry 2e
items.note: Complete general-chemistry course text with worked examples and answer keys. Official page, free PDF download. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. PDF 208 MB.

items.name: OpenStax College Physics 2e
items.note: Algebra-based intro physics, full text plus problem sets — no calculus prerequisite. Official page, PDF download. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. PDF 251 MB.

items.name: OpenStax U.S. History
items.note: Complete US survey history, pre-Columbian to present. Solid offline civics and PME study text. Official page, PDF download. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. PDF 130 MB.

items.name: OpenStax Psychology 2e
items.note: Full intro psychology text and one of the smaller OpenStax PDFs — a good first download when drive space is tight. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. PDF 55 MB.

items.name: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e
items.note: Two-semester A&P with full illustration set; useful for medic, EMT and nursing prep offline. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Largest here at 454 MB.

items.name: OpenStax College Algebra 2e
items.note: Full college algebra with practice problems and answer keys. Core math for CLEP/DSST and college prep without a connection. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. PDF 80 MB.

items.name: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1
items.note: Limits, derivatives and integrals; first of three volumes, vols 2 and 3 link from the same site. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. PDF 50 MB.

items.name: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e
items.note: Arithmetic through introductory algebra — the right starting point for brushing up or teaching kids offline. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. PDF 60 MB.

items.name: OpenStax Concepts of Biology
items.note: Non-majors biology survey; the lighter alternative to Biology 2e if storage is tight. Official page, PDF download. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. PDF 177 MB.

items.name: OpenStax Astronomy 2e
items.note: Full introductory astronomy text; pairs well with offline star charts for night-sky and celestial-navigation learning. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. PDF 155 MB.

items.name: OpenStax Introduction to Sociology 3e
items.note: Full intro sociology text and the smallest book on this list — fits easily alongside the bigger science PDFs. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. PDF 46 MB.

items.name: LibreTexts Mathematics Bookshelves
items.note: LibreTexts math library: arithmetic through calculus, linear algebra, differential equations. Each book offers Download Full Book (PDF). CC licenses vary by title; size varies.

items.name: LibreTexts Chemistry Bookshelves
items.note: LibreTexts chemistry library: intro/GOB, general, organic, analytical, physical, biological. Per-book full-PDF download. CC licenses vary by title; size varies.

items.name: Open Textbook Library
items.note: Univ. of Minnesota's index of 1,866 openly licensed textbooks across all subjects, with faculty peer reviews. Most offer direct PDF download. Licenses and sizes vary by book.
